title: NavigationAgent2D gets stuck at partition lines
body:
### Tested versions

Version v4.8.dev1.official [ebbf577a0]

### System information

Godot v4.8.dev1 - Windows 11 (build 26100) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Direct3D 12 (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4080 Laptop GPU (NVIDIA; 32.0.16.1074) - 13th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i9-13900HX (32 threads) - 63.74 GiB memory - WASAPI (48000 Hz, Stereo/mono)

### Issue description

It gets stuck not near obstacles, not near anything. Just at partition lines. 
Changing partition type and rebaking the navigation layer fixes it temporarily

At video below agent has simple logic:
```gdscript
func _physics_process(_delta):
	var next_point = navigation_agent.get_next_path_position()
	var direction = entity.global_position.direction_to(next_point)
	navigation_agent.velocity = direction * speed
```

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/0be42a1e-92cf-49e9-af4b-1d7ba8b1ac6d

Yellow and blue circles are debug for path:
```gdscript
	var points = navigation_agent.get_current_navigation_path()

	for point in points: # nav_path
		draw_circle(
			to_local(point),
			5,
			Color.YELLOW
		)

	# Draw next point the agent is moving toward
	if not navigation_agent.is_navigation_finished():
		var next_point = navigation_agent.get_next_path_position()

		draw_circle(
			to_local(next_point),
			8,
			Color.BLUE
		)
```

### Steps to reproduce

Create navigation agent and navigation region.
Add some static body's to source geometry, rebake.

Make movement of agent:
```gdscript
func _physics_process(_delta):
	var next_point = navigation_agent.get_next_path_position()
	var direction = entity.global_position.direction_to(next_point)
	navigation_agent.velocity = direction * speed
```

Issue will happen randomly when agent crosses navigation region partition line

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[mini.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/30973611/mini.zip)
